title: Create a TypeScript composable
note: Plain .ts rather than an SFC — isolates whether SFC structure is the problem or code generation generally is.
prompt: Create src/composables/useCounter.ts exporting a function useCounter(initial = 0). It returns { count, increment, decrement, reset } where count is a ref and the three functions mutate it. reset returns count to the initial value. Type it properly; no `any`.
